mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1 AND I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = #{SEARCH_JOB_INSTANCE_ID} AND I.JOB_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{SEARCH_JOB_NAME}, '%')
AND E.START_TIME >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{SEARCH_START_DT_FROM}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.START_TIME >= STR_TO_DATE(#{SEARCH_START_DT_FROM}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')
AND E.START_TIME <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{SEARCH_START_DT_TO}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND E.START_TIME <= STR_TO_DATE(#{SEARCH_START_DT_TO}, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION E INNER JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE I ON E.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID

SELECT E.JOB_EXECUTION_ID , I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID , I.JOB_NAME , E.STATUS , E.CREATE_TIME , E.START_TIME , E.END_TIME , E.EXIT_CODE , E.EXIT_MESSAGE , E.LAST_UPDATED FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION E INNER JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE I ON E.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND E.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = #{jobExecutionId}

SELECT E.JOB_EXECUTION_ID , I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID , I.JOB_NAME , E.STATUS , E.CREATE_TIME , E.START_TIME , E.END_TIME , E.EXIT_CODE , E.EXIT_MESSAGE , E.LAST_UPDATED FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION E INNER JOIN BATCH_JOB_INSTANCE I ON E.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.JOB_INSTANCE_ID = #{jobInstanceId} ORDER BY E.JOB_EXECUTION_ID DESC

SELECT S.STEP_EXECUTION_ID , S.STEP_NAME , S.JOB_EXECUTION_ID , S.STATUS , S.START_TIME , S.END_TIME , S.COMMIT_COUNT , S.READ_COUNT , S.WRITE_COUNT , S.FILTER_COUNT , S.READ_SKIP_COUNT , S.WRITE_SKIP_COUNT , S.PROCESS_SKIP_COUNT , S.ROLLBACK_COUNT , S.EXIT_CODE , S.EXIT_MESSAGE FROM BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION S WHERE 1=1 AND S.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = #{jobExecutionId} ORDER BY S.STEP_EXECUTION_ID
SELECT P.PARAMETER_NAME , P.PARAMETER_TYPE , P.PARAMETER_VALUE , P.IDENTIFYING FROM BATCH_JOB_EXECUTION_PARAMS P WHERE 1=1 AND P.JOB_EXECUTION_ID = #{jobExecutionId} ORDER BY P.PARAMETER_NAME
